The '''Northern Reaches''' was a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] continent [[Keshtah Minor]]. In [[4975 BBY]], [[Jariad Korsin]], [[High Lord]] of Kesh's [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], in an attempt to distract his [[Yaru Korsin|father]] from a plotted [[Duel near the Kesh Sith Temple|coup]] by claiming he was going to the Northern Reaches on a training mission with a group of [[Sith Saber]] warriors.
